title: School-holiday birthday near Westmead or Constitution Hill? 100% eggless
summary:
Birthday in the summer school holidays, party at home in Westmead or Constitution Hill? The cake is the one thing nobody has to check for egg.

Every cake at our Harris Park shop on Wigram Street is 100% eggless. Not some of them. All 15 flavours, every size, every design. Vegetarian grandparents, Jain relatives and the cousin with an egg allergy can all have a slice without asking.

Sizing for a family party: a 10-inch serves 20-22 from $74.99. An 8-inch serves 12-14 from $49.99. Send a photo of the design you want and we make it.

Give us 2 days' notice. Pickup from Harris Park, open 11am to 10pm, 7 days, under 2 km from Parramatta CBD.

A holiday birthday has enough moving parts. The cake does not need to be one of them. 🎂
